newsitem.title: UK: Energy Group sees power trading growth.
newsitem.headline: Energy Group sees power trading growth.

text.p: British-based Energy Group Plc said on Thursday it expected operating profit from its power and energy trading operations to reach at least 100 million stg by the end of the decade from its current level of 40 million stg.

The company said the growth would be fuelled by the full integration of recently-acquired U.S.-based marketer Citizens Lehman Power LLC and the development of the Power and Energy Trading business in Britain, the U.S. and Australia.
The company made the statement in a news release issued after an analysts' briefing.
Energy Group's shares rose 17-1/2p on Thursday to close at 507, boosted by an upgrade by Goldman Sachs.
On Wednesday, Goldman added the stock to its recommended list from a previous outperform rating.
